attr.title: oxGBC
attr.desc: A Game Boy and Game Boy Color emulator written in Rust: sub-instruction CPU timing and a dot-level PPU, validated in CI against Blargg, Mooneye, SameSuite, dmg-acid2, cgb-acid2 and cgb-acid-hell. Gamepad-first UI: a cartridge library with cover art as a shelf, a list or a carousel, save-state slots with previews and play time, rewind, turbo and slow motion, GLSL shaders, colour palettes for mono games, and every button rebindable. Bring your own cartridges.
attr.inst: Ready to run. Put .gb or .gbc files (or a zip of one) in your Game Boy folder beside your ROMs: a `gbc`, `gb` or `gameboy` folder is shelved on the first launch, and any other folder can be picked from the in-app browser. Battery saves, save states and settings stay in ports/oxgbc.
